descriptionHtml:
It was a technical workshop organized in collaboration with MethG Pvt 
Ltd, aimed at providing in-depth knowledge about industrial automation. 
The session covered key aspects of automation systems, including PLC 
programming and real-world applications, offering participants valuable 
insights into the field. With the active participation of about 30 students, 
the workshop concluded successfully, creating an excellent opportunity 
for attendees to gain hands-on experience and network with industry 
professionals.
venue: AR Building, Seminar Room 2, Faculty of Engineering
